title: GitHub - kol3x/pawmc: Pawmc: Private Assistant with Managed Context
excerpt: Pawmc: Private Assistant with Managed Context. Contribute to kol3x/pawmc development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
A personal LLM assistant that runs on Cloudflare Workers and maintains a user-guided compounding knowledge base across conversations.

When starting a new conversation, choose which historical context you want it to have by choosing a category and topic. Additional context from new chats is compounded daily or on request.

It's simple and lightweight, and you own your data, pick your model, and control the prompts.

Key advantages

Compounding context that works

Pawmc asks for a little effort from a user, but the result is predictability of compounding context. Every time you start a chat, you must select a "category" and "topic" (existing or new) and that's exactly where the context will compound.

Over time, when you gather context about your fields of interest, you will have multiple context options to use as a background for your new chats. (e.g. "personal", "project-x", "hobby-y", "philosophy")

Simplicity

It's a great relief to use an LLM that doesn't have search-access and a system prompt of 200–1500 (!) lines. Pawmc's system prompt is one short sentence, focused on getting the point across.

Control over data

You deploy the software, you control the database. The database includes all your conversations and summaries. You can redact your summaries, you can redact your prompts, you can change the model.

In an ideal world, you would also control the LLM deployment, but as of mid-2026 most of us can't host a cutting-edge LLM on a private machine. It's the main tradeoff - prompts are still sent to the companies that host LLMs.

Cost

Deploying and hosting Pawmc on Cloudflare is way under their free tier limits, and you even get some free daily tokens with Workers AI.

Features

  • Conversation Storage: Stores conversations by category and topic
  • Context-Aware: Maintains AI-generated summaries for each category and topic
  • Daily Summaries: Automatically updates summaries via cron daily
  • API Key Auth: Secure access with Bearer token authentication
  • Web Interface: Chat UI at the root URL

Setup

1. Create your own copy

Click "Use this template" on the GitHub repo to create your own repository.

2. Create a Cloudflare account

Go to dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up and create a free account. No credit card required.

3. Create an API token

  1. Go to dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
  2. Click Create Token
  3. Click Use template next to "Edit Cloudflare Workers"
  4. Under Account Resources, select your account
  5. Click Continue to summary, then Create Token
  6. Copy the token — you'll need it in the next step

4. Add secrets to GitHub

In your new GitHub repository:

  1. Go to Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
  2. Click New repository secret
  3. Add these two secrets:
Name Value
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN The API token you created in step 3
API_KEY A secret password of your choice (you'll enter this in the web app to log in)

5. Deploy

  1. In your GitHub repository click the Actions tab
  2. Select the Deploy workflow from the left sidebar
  3. Under three dots button on the right choose Run workflow option

Once deployed, you can put together a link to your worker, based on the email you used to register on Cloudflare, like in the example below.

replaceme@gmail.com => 
https://pawmc.replaceme.workers.dev

Open that URL, enter your API_KEY and start chatting.

Advanced: Use OpenRouter instead of Workers AI

By default, Pawmc uses Cloudflare Workers AI (free, no extra setup). However, Workers AI can be unreliable and is only ok for testing out the project. If you are planning to use it extensively, I recommend switching to OpenRouter, which is also supported.

Note that OpenRouter is pay-per-token — you'll need to add credit to your OpenRouter account (supports crypto as well). However, it's usually a symbolical spending due to project's simplicity and the budget-friendly model default.

To switch:

  1. Create an account at openrouter.ai and generate an API key.
  2. In your GitHub repository, go to Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions and add a new secret named OPENROUTER_API_KEY with your key.
  3. In wrangler.jsonc, set AI_PROVIDER to "openrouter" and, if you want a different model, update AI_MODEL_OPENROUTER to any OpenRouter model slug.
  4. Commit and push the change (or run the Deploy action) to redeploy.

To switch back, set AI_PROVIDER back to "workers-ai".

Getting updates

When the template repo is updated, go to your GitHub repo, click Sync fork → Update branch, and the action will redeploy automatically.

Free Tier Cloudflare Workers Limits

Resource Limit
Workers Requests 100,000/day
Workers AI 10,000 neurons/day
SQLite Row Reads 5 million/day
SQLite Row Writes 100,000/day
Cron Triggers 5/account

Pawmc 要求用户付出一点努力，但结果是复合上下文的可预测性。 每次开始聊天时，您都必须选择一个“类别”和“主题”（现有的或新的），而这正是上下文复合的地方。

随着时间的推移，当您收集有关您感兴趣的领域的上下文时，您将有多个上下文选项可用作新聊天的背景。 （例如“个人”、“项目-x”、“爱好-y”、“哲学”）

简单

使用没有搜索访问权限且系统提示为 200-1500（！） 的 LLM 是一种很大的缓解。 线。 Pawmc 的系统提示是一个简短的句子，重点是表达要点。

对数据的控制

您部署软件，您控制数据库。 该数据库包含您的所有对话和摘要。 您可以编辑您的摘要，您可以编辑您的提示，您可以更改模型。

在理想的情况下，您还可以控制 LLM 部署，但截至 2026 年中期，我们大多数人都无法在私人计算机上托管最先进的 LLM。 这是主要的权衡——提示仍然会发送给拥有法学硕士的公司。

Cost

在 Cloudflare 上部署和托管 Pawmc 远低于其免费套餐限制，您甚至可以通过 Workers AI 获得一些免费的每日代币。

特征

  • 对话存储：按类别和主题存储对话
  • 上下文感知：维护人工智能为每个类别和主题生成的摘要
  • 每日摘要：每天通过 cron 自动更新摘要
  • API 密钥身份验证：通过不记名令牌身份验证进行安全访问
  • Web 界面：根 URL 处的聊天 UI

Setup

1. 创建您自己的副本

单击 GitHub 存储库上的“使用此模板”以创建您自己的存储库。

2. 创建 Cloudflare 帐户

访问 dash.cloudflare.com/sign-up 并创建一个免费帐户。 无需信用卡。

3. 创建 API 令牌

  1. 转至 dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
  2. 单击创建令牌
  3. 单击“编辑 Cloudflare Workers”旁边的使用模板
  4. 在帐户资源下，选择您的帐户
  5. 单击继续摘要，然后单击创建令牌
  6. 复制令牌 - 您将在下一步中需要它

4. 将机密添加到 GitHub

在您的新 GitHub 存储库中：

  1. 转到设置 → 秘密和变量 → 操作
  2. 单击新建存储库机密
  3. 添加这两个秘密：
Name Value
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN 您在步骤 3 中创建的 API 令牌
API_KEY 您选择的秘密密码（您将在网络应用程序中输入此密码进行登录）

5. 部署

  1. 在 GitHub 存储库中单击“操作”选项卡
  2. 从左侧边栏中选择部署工作流程
  3. 在右侧的三个点按钮下，选择“运行工作流程”选项

部署后，您可以根据您在 Cloudflare 上注册时使用的电子邮件，创建指向您的工作人员的链接，如下例所示。

replaceme@gmail.com => 
https://pawmc.replaceme.workers.dev

打开该 URL，输入您的 API_KEY 并开始聊天。

高级：使用 OpenRouter 代替 Workers AI

默认情况下，Pawmc 使用 Cloudflare Workers AI（免费，无需额外设置）。 然而，Workers AI 可能不可靠，只能用于测试项目。 如果您打算广泛使用它，我建议切换到 OpenRouter，它也受支持。

请注意，OpenRouter 是按代币付费的 - 您需要向您的 OpenRouter 帐户添加信用（也支持加密）。 然而，由于项目的简单性和默认的预算友好型模型，这通常是象征性的支出。

切换：

  1. 在 openrouter.ai 创建帐户并生成 API 密钥。
  2. 在 GitHub 存储库中，转到“设置”→“机密和变量”→“操作”，然后使用您的密钥添加一个名为 OPENROUTER_API_KEY 的新机密。
  3. 在 wrangler.jsonc 中，将 AI_PROVIDER 设置为“openrouter”，如果您想要不同的模型，请将 AI_MODEL_OPENROUTER 更新为任何 OpenRouter 模型 slug。
  4. 提交并推送更改（或运行部署操作）以重新部署。

要切换回来，请将 AI_PROVIDER 设置回“workers-ai”。

获取更新

更新模板存储库后，转到您的 GitHub 存储库，单击同步分支 → 更新分支，该操作将自动重新部署。
